$comment: Workflow hygiene for .github/workflows. forbiddenTriggers and write-all apply to every workflow. The remaining rules apply to fork-local workflows only (everything not in upstream-owned.json): top-level permissions present and read-only, every action pinned to a full commit SHA, no attacker-controlled event text interpolated into run scripts. Evaluated by scripts/check-policies.mjs. See docs/security/SECURITY-AI.md.
